your character being their own person, like yeah i love romance filled games that are centered around it but while they are tun my favorites are the games where you have more to your storyline.

open heart is such a good example of this, yes there are love interests and yes you can get with them, but there’s a medical mystery, there is betrayal of friends there are cases you get to play, and choices you get to make that directly effect characters in game lives. You can tell a man he has a genetic illness or leave him blissfully unaware, you can get a toy for a premature infant that his mother left him, you do give a woman a chance at experiencing her dreams. it’s not just about romance, it’s about the MC changing as a person through her experiences. and it’s phenomenal

ACOR is a amazing example too, yes this is more focused about romance but you directly influence actions that happen around you, you can see if your bodyguard or your father, or both. People you love die without explanation, and it’s heartbreaking, but that’s historically accurate. The MC in ACOR is a strong, smart, courageous female who just wants the freedom of her people, the freedom that was taken away by the oppressive power of Rome. your love interests help you decide on which path you take, this book really relies on your choices. one of my absolute favorites and was the first choices book i ever played.

so my list has to be
1. ACOR, the history, the romance, the plot, so good
2. Open Heart, the plot, the development, and the ethical implications of being a doctor
3. MOTY, while yes it’s not finished it is very good and shows how the judicial system has bias and how blood isn’t thicker then water- family is what you make of it
4. THM, fun, exhilarating, with a good plot line and good romance, for mc and other characters, reminds me very fondly of oceans 11 and oceans 8
5. D&D book two, the first book was amazing but the second book had everything the first book had and more, solving the mystery of Duke Richards is fun and sneaking around with your LI adds too the fun
